column1: # QEMU virt's two 64 MiB CFI flash banks (-drive if=pflash), which Linux sees as one MTD, 0.flash: the first
# holds U-Boot, which the machine runs from address 0, and is otherwise erased; all of the second is the UBI
# partition. The erase block is the banks' 256 KiB sector, NOR writes single bytes, and UBI puts its VID header
# right after the 64-byte erase counter header. Tab-separated rows (src/image/flash-layout.ts):
